hooks.command: input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(npm run -s ds:check 2>&1); [ $? -eq 2 ] || exit 0; printf 'Design-system check found new violations. Fix them, or add `ds-ignore: <reason>` where the exception is deliberate (scripts/ds/README.md):\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2
